case_creation_requests_decided_check.name: case_creation_requests_decided_check
case_creation_requests_decided_check.value: "case_creation_requests"."status" = 'pending' or ("case_creation_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "case_creation_requests"."decided_by" is not null)

case_todos_assignee_check.name: case_todos_assignee_check
case_todos_assignee_check.value: "case_todos"."assignee_id" is null or ("case_todos"."recorded_assignee_id" is not null and "case_todos"."assignee_id" = "case_todos"."recorded_assignee_id")

case_todos_completed_assignee_check.name: case_todos_completed_assignee_check
case_todos_completed_assignee_check.value: ("case_todos"."completed_assignee_id" is null) = ("case_todos"."completed_assignee_name" is null) and ("case_todos"."is_done" = 1 or "case_todos"."completed_assignee_id" is null)

cases_case_number_check.name: cases_case_number_check
cases_case_number_check.value: length("cases"."case_number") = 15 and substr("cases"."case_number", 1, 3) glob '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]' and substr("cases"."case_number", 4, 1) = '-' and substr("cases"."case_number", 5, 6) glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' and substr("cases"."case_number", 11, 1) = '-' and substr("cases"."case_number", 12, 4) glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'

channel_archive_events_reason_check.name: channel_archive_events_reason_check
channel_archive_events_reason_check.value: "channel_archive_events"."reason" is null or length("channel_archive_events"."reason") between 1 and 500

channel_creation_requests_decided_check.name: channel_creation_requests_decided_check
channel_creation_requests_decided_check.value: "channel_creation_requests"."status" = 'pending' or ("channel_creation_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "channel_creation_requests"."decided_by" is not null)

channels_department_purpose_check.name: channels_department_purpose_check
channels_department_purpose_check.value: "channels"."purpose" not in ('department', 'announcement') or ("channels"."department_id" is not null and "channels"."visibility" = 'public')

retirement_requests_decided_check.name: retirement_requests_decided_check
retirement_requests_decided_check.value: "retirement_requests"."status" = 'pending' or ("retirement_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "retirement_requests"."decided_by" is not null)

user_role_assignments_scope_check.name: user_role_assignments_scope_check
user_role_assignments_scope_check.value: ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'company' and "user_role_assignments"."department_id" is null) or ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'department' and "user_role_assignments"."department_id" is not null)
